methods.name: PhoneMetadata getFormattingMetadataForCountryCallingCode(int countryCallingCode)
methods.comment:
* Returns formatting phone metadata for provided country calling code. * *

This method is similar to the one in {@link * NonGeographicalEntityMetadataSource#getMetadataForNonGeographicalRegion(int)}, except that it * will not fail for geographical regions, it can be used for both geo- and non-geo entities. * *

In case the provided {@code countryCallingCode} maps to several different regions, only one * would contain formatting metadata. * * @return the phone metadata for provided {@code countryCallingCode}, or null if there is none.
